sources.entry: SlowQuitApps - An OS X app that adds a global delay of 1 second to the Cmd-Q shortcut. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon] ![Freeware][Freeware Icon]](https://github.com/dteoh/SlowQuitApps)
SlowQuitApps - Add a global delay to Command-Q to stop accidental app quits.

summary.one_liner: SlowQuitApps is a macOS app that adds a global 1-second hold delay to the Cmd-Q shortcut so accidental quits are prevented.
summary.what_it_does: It requires the user to hold Cmd-Q for a set delay (1 second by default) before the frontmost application quits. While the delay is active, an overlay showing the time remaining is drawn at the center of the screen. The delay is configurable in milliseconds via the macOS defaults system. A whitelist of bundle IDs can be set so those apps receive Cmd-Q immediately, and an inverted "blacklist mode" lets the app handle Cmd-Q only for listed apps. The overlay can be turned off with a defaults setting. The README says the approach mirrors Google Chrome's "Warn Before Quitting" feature, applied to every app.
use_cases: prevent accidental app quits on macOS
add a confirmation delay to Command-Q
stop losing browser tabs from a stray Cmd-Q
exempt specific apps from the quit delay
disable or tune Cmd-Q behavior system-wide
how_to_run: Or download pre-built binaries from the releases page, unzip, drag to Applications, and run
defaults write com.dteoh.SlowQuitApps delay -int 5000  (example: set delay to 5 seconds)
defaults write com.dteoh.SlowQuitApps whitelist -array-add com.apple.Notes  (example whitelist entry)
killall SlowQuitApps  (exit before relaunching after changes)
notable: Global 1-second hold-to-quit on Cmd-Q for every app
Whitelist of apps that bypass the delay, plus an inverted blacklist mode
Optional sqa command-line script when installed via Homebrew
caveats: Currently developed and supported only on Mojave; older macOS versions need pinned older releases (0.5.0 for 10.9 to 10.13, 0.4.0 for 10.8)
After upgrading, accessibility permissions must be removed and re-added manually
Settings require exiting and relaunching the app to take effect
